findings.title: Sales are still used as demand under stockout conditions
findings.failure_mode: Observed sales during empty-shelf periods can be learned as true demand.
findings.required_test: Create a zero-sale, zero-stock row and assert canonical output marks censored demand and downstream training can exclude or adjust it.
findings.acceptance_gate: Canonical rows include is_censored_demand and forecast metrics report censored-row rate.

findings.title: Calibration is global rather than segment-aware
findings.failure_mode: Aggregate coverage can pass while priority store, product, promotion, or shelf-life segments under-cover.
findings.required_test: Build two demand segments with different error distributions and assert segment coverage and alerts are reported separately.
findings.acceptance_gate: Monitoring fails when any priority segment coverage is below the configured floor.

findings.title: Product and store encodings can drift between training and scoring
findings.failure_mode: Category codes are recomputed per frame and can map the same product or store to different values later.
findings.required_test: Compare encodings for a full training frame and a filtered scoring frame.
findings.acceptance_gate: Model artifacts persist vocabularies and scoring uses stable mappings plus an unknown category.

findings.title: Simulator event order is fixed but business-critical
findings.failure_mode: Expiry, receiving, shrinkage, sales, and ordering sequence can change fill and waste metrics materially.
findings.required_test: Use one-day shelf-life fixtures to assert expected outcomes under each supported event-order mode.
findings.acceptance_gate: Simulator supports named event-order modes and records the selected mode in outputs.

findings.title: Policy promotion does not enforce service floors
findings.failure_mode: A lower-cost policy can be favored even when it violates required availability for a priority segment.
findings.required_test: Create policy metrics where the cheapest policy violates the fill-rate floor and assert it is rejected.
findings.acceptance_gate: Policy ranking minimizes cost subject to global and segment-level service floors.

findings.title: Cloud workflow is not verified end to end
findings.failure_mode: Local helper tests can pass while cloud IAM, job execution, or partition publication fails.
findings.required_test: Run dry-run publication against fake or sandbox clients and assert execution order.
findings.acceptance_gate: CI or optional integration checks validate dbt, DAG import, and publication flow.

findings.title: dbt models lack fixture-backed validation in CI
findings.failure_mode: Warehouse SQL can break without failing the current Python-only CI checks.
findings.required_test: Run dbt parse and a fixture-backed build or SQL compilation check in CI.
findings.acceptance_gate: CI includes dbt validation for staging, intermediate, and mart models.
